transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As part of the charter-review process for the cross-team planning forum, I want to check in with each of you before we finalize any changes. We know the current open-discussion format has made it hard for some participants to raise concerns, and there's no consistent advance-notice standard or designated neutral facilitator right now. I'd like to hear your thoughts on what we should change. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I'd be happy to share some thoughts. I think having a designated neutral facilitator would make a big difference, and it would help to have the agenda shared at least 48 hours in advance so people can prepare. Structured discussion rather than fully open discussion would also help make sure concerns can actually surface. I do have some specific context about requirements related to these areas that I think is relevant here, and I'd like to share it with the group.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thanks, Taylor — those are solid suggestions, and I agree that a designated facilitator and advance agenda notice would address a lot of what's been coming up. Before we go further, I should put something on the table. I've been tracking interruptions during the forum, and I recorded exactly three occasions in the last month where participants were publicly interrupted while raising concerns. I think that data point is directly relevant to why we need these changes, and it should be reflected in the charter draft I'm putting together for Leah.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thanks both of you — really helpful input. Taylor, I'd definitely like to hear that specific context about requirements you mentioned, so please go ahead and share it with the group. Morgan, that interruption data is valuable — three documented instances in the last month is concrete evidence that the current format isn't working for surfacing concerns. I'd like to make sure that's reflected in the charter draft. Before I finalize anything, I still want to make sure I've heard from everyone, so let's keep going.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should let everyone know that I have an approved workplace arrangement that directly relates to this. The arrangement requires the planning forum to use structured discussion with a designated neutral facilitator, requires the agenda to be shared at least 48 hours in advance, and prohibits unscripted cold-calling during group discussions. I hadn't raised it earlier because it's normally handled through my direct manager, but since we're reviewing the charter right now, it's clearly relevant and I want to make sure it's on record as part of this process.
transcript.speaker: A2
